treeViews.canvas.en: Tree canvas: drag to pan, wheel to pan vertically, Shift+wheel to pan horizontally, Ctrl+wheel to zoom at pointer, +/- to zoom, 0 to fit, Down to focus nodes
treeViews.canvas.zh-CN: 树画布：拖动平移，滚轮上下平移，Shift+滚轮左右平移，Ctrl+滚轮以鼠标位置缩放，加减号缩放，0 适应完整树，下方向键聚焦节点

treeViews.navigationHint.en: Drag to pan · Wheel ↑↓ · Shift+wheel ←→ · Ctrl+wheel zoom · 0 to fit
treeViews.navigationHint.zh-CN: 拖动平移 · 滚轮上下 · Shift+滚轮左右 · Ctrl+滚轮缩放 · 0 适应完整树

treeViews.largeGraph.en: This tree has {{count}} expanded nodes. Drawing all nodes can be expensive. Collapse folders or use the directory list for a large repository, or explicitly draw the complete graph. No nodes will be omitted.
treeViews.largeGraph.zh-CN: 当前树有 {{count}} 个展开节点，完整绘制可能较慢。大仓库可先收起目录或使用目录列表，也可选择绘制完整图形；不会省略节点。

treeViews.visibleCount.en: {{visible}} nodes in viewport / {{count}} expanded or matching nodes
treeViews.visibleCount.zh-CN: 视口内 {{visible}} 个节点 / 共 {{count}} 个展开或匹配节点

treeViews.searchPaths.en: Matching full paths; folder expansion is preserved
treeViews.searchPaths.zh-CN: 匹配完整路径，保留目录展开状态
